coreMemory.english: v. to hold, carry, move, or remove someone or something；v. to require or use an amount of time, space, or effort；v. to participate in an activity or event；v. to perform an action expressed by a noun
coreMemory.structure: take your time /ˈteɪk ˈjɔːr ˈtaɪm/（慢慢来；不用着急）；take part in something /ˈteɪk ˈpɑrt ɪn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（参加某事）；take a break /ˈteɪk ə ˈbreɪk/（休息一下）；take responsibility for something /ˈteɪk riːˌspɑnsəˈbɪlətiː ˈfɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（为某事负责）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ it takes time doing something → ✅ it takes time to do something；❌ take part something → ✅ take part in something

commonErrors.right: it takes time to do something
commonErrors.note: 这个结构要用 take + to + 动词原形；do 只是词卡里的动词占位符，真实句子要换成 finish、check 等具体动词。
在“take part in something”这个常用搭配中，介词 in 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。

coreMemory.example: Take your time and read the whole question.

meanings.example: Please take this book to the front desk.

meanings.english: to require or use an amount of time, space, or effort

meanings.translation: 建立主动词汇需要时间。

meanings.english: to participate in an activity or event
meanings.example: I plan to take part in the weekly speaking practice.
meanings.translation: 我打算参加每周口语练习。

meanings.english: to perform an action expressed by a noun
meanings.example: We should take responsibility for our own mistakes.
meanings.translation: 我们应该为自己的错误负责。

synonyms.difference: accept 侧重“接受；接纳”。对应的常用英文义是 “to carry, accept, require, or perform an action”。take 在本卡搭配“take your time”中表达“拿”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“拿”这个义项下，give（给；交出）与 take 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of take”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。

derivatives.note: 较少见，表示外表或举止吸引人。
taker 是 take 的常用词族形式，作 n. 使用；对应的常用英文义是 “one who accepts an offer”。

confusables.difference: bring 表示“带来；产生；促使”；take 在本卡核心搭配“take your time”中表示“拿”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。
